# Nishitani Keiji

*1900 – 1990 · Japanese · [Kyoto School](../movements/kyoto-school.md)*

Student of [Nishida](../philosophers/nishida.md) and of [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md), a major figure of the [Kyoto School](../movements/kyoto-school.md), thinker of the overcoming of nihilism through emptiness.
